ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision system running on Raspberry Pi that detects worker safety violations locally at the edge without cloud dependency.
ideas.title: EdgeGuard: Industrial PPE & Safety Violation Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hardware-focused judging panels love working physical demos that solve critical industrial safety issues, directly matching patterns from previous winning industrial safety edge systems.

ideas.pitch: An ESP32-based biomedical telemetry device that monitors vital signs and flags anomalies locally before transmitting encrypted data via Wi-Fi.
ideas.title: BioStream: Edge IoT Post-Operative Health Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Biomedical Engineering domain with a physical embedded sensor kit gives teams a massive edge in hardware hackathons where judges evaluate circuit wiring and real-time telemetry.

ideas.pitch: An ESP32-powered handheld scanner that reads physical analog signatures and conductive ink traces to authenticate high-value components at the edge.
ideas.title: VeriSign: Hardware-Secured Anti-Counterfeiting Tag
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex hardware integration combining sensors and microcontrollers, directly echoing winning supply chain security projects.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-implemented digital signal processor filter on an FPGA board for real-time biomedical or communication signal denoising.
ideas.title: FPGA-Accelerated Real-Time Noise Filter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the FPGA track with true low-level hardware design, showcasing genuine hard engineering that standard software teams cannot replicate.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-accelerated image classification pipeline deployed on an FPGA board to instantly sort recyclable materials via sensor integration.
ideas.title: EcoSort: FPGA-Based Edge Garbage Classification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with FPGA hardware acceleration, standing out through a compelling live sorting demonstration.
